title: Preserve task model override across lifecycles, set auto-compaction strictly at 100% context_window, and auto-sync tool policies to persona.md
commitMessage: feat(tasks): preserve task model override, fix compaction threshold, and sync tool policies
author: agent-developer (tauri-rust-engineer)
summary: Fixed task model reset bug by accepting and persisting model in create_task, adding update_task command, inheriting parent_model in create_subtask, and reloading fresh tasks from disk in run_agent. Changed auto-compaction threshold to trigger strictly at current_tokens >= context_window (100%). Added sync_tool_policies_to_personas to auto-reconcile tool policy matrix with persona.md frontmatter.
